description: This file contains JavaScript code defining a module for managing SugarCharts within the SuiteCRM project. The code initializes a namespace, provides functions for loading and adding charts to an internal data structure associated with specific active tabs, and manages chart configuration details.

methods.name: initmySugarCharts()
methods.description: Initializes the SugarCharts management object, returning an object with methods to load and add charts.

methods.name: loadSugarCharts
methods.description: Loads charts for a specified active tab, invoking an external function loadSugarChart() for each chart.

methods.name: addToChartsArrayJson
methods.description: Adds multiple charts from a JSON object to the charts array for a specified active tab, calling addToChartsArray() internally.

methods.name: addToChartsArray
methods.description: Adds a single chart to the charts array for a specified active tab, creating the sub-array if necessary.
